name: polyv-live-ops
description: PolyV live streaming operations expert that drives polyv-live-cli via Bash to manage channels, streams, playbacks, products, coupons and viewer data, with pre-live checklists, live monitoring and post-live review playbooks.

displayDescription.en: Inspects and manages PolyV live channels, streams, playbacks, products and viewer data through the polyv-live-cli, covering pre-live checklists, live monitoring and post-live data review.
displayDescription.zh: 基于保利威云直播命令行，实时查询频道、推流、回放与观看数据，覆盖开播检查、直播监控与播后复盘。
